notes.title: Maintenance and Update Announcement - August 14th
notes.content:
Dear \[Call of Clans] Players,

To bring you an even more exciting gaming experience and improved features, we are scheduled to perform server maintenance and an update on August 14, 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for approximately 2 hours.

During this period, you will be temporarily unable to log into the game. Please plan your game time accordingly. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

The key updates are as follows:

【New Team Challenge! The "Ultimate Ruins" Arrive!】

A brand-new, high-difficulty team PVE mode, the "Ultimate Ruins", is now open! Gather your allies, challenge unprecedentedly powerful foes, and earn exclusive, bountiful rewards!

【Power Awakens! All-New Follower Awakening System!】

A new chapter in follower progression begins! Consume specific materials to help your followers break their limits, gain the power of Awakening, and unlock enhanced stats and skill effects!

The first batch of followers available for Awakening includes:

\[Gale Swordsman], \[Moon Priest], \[Flaming Wings], \[Purple Dragon], \[Skeleton King], \[Divine Warrior]

【A Mark of a New Power Level! New Awakening Card Frames】

When a Legendary (Orange) card reaches a specific Awakening level, it will receive a new visual upgrade:

5-Star Awakening: The card frame will upgrade to a striking Red Frame!

6-Star Awakening: The card frame will transform into a dazzling Prismatic Frame, a true symbol of your honor!

【Borderless Communication! World Chat Added to Team-Play】

A World Chat channel has now been added to the team-play feature, making it easier for you to find teammates and discuss strategies.

【A Boon for Newcomers! Card Synergy Recommendations Added】

A new Synergy Recommendation feature has been added to the details page of all Legendary (Orange) and Epic (Purple) cards. This will help you easily master powerful card combinations and build strong lineups faster!

【Battle Pace Quickens! New Late-Game Acceleration Mechanic】

To make the later stages of matches more intense and thrilling, an Acceleration Mechanic will now trigger starting from Round 15:

Card Draw x2 each turn!

Standby Reduction x2 each turn (actions resolve faster)!

Thank you for your continuous support! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Maintenance and Update Announcement - August 7th
notes.content:
Dear \[Call of Clans] Players,

To provide you with an enhanced gaming experience, we are scheduled to perform server maintenance and an update on August 7th, 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours.

During this period, you will be temporarily unable to log into the game. Please plan your game time accordingly and log off in advance to avoid any unnecessary inconvenience. We sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause.

The key updates are as follows:

【Deck Rebirth! New Card Level Swap Feature】

Deck-building just got a major upgrade! Introducing the Legendary Card Level Swap feature. Each season, you will have the chance to swap the levels of any two Legendary cards of your choice. Experiment with different core cards at zero cost and make your strategies more flexible than ever!

【Season Boost Upgraded for Your Choice】

The Season Boost feature has been optimized! After purchasing the Season Battle Pass, you will now have the ability to choose which cards to boost, allowing you to precisely enhance your favorite cards for the new season!

【Game Pace Increased! Chest Timers Drastically Reduced】

Say goodbye to long waits! We have significantly reduced the unlocking time for all PVP Battle Chests, helping you get your rewards and grow faster!

【Battle Pass Missions Eased】

To make it easier for everyone to claim Battle Pass rewards, we have lowered the difficulty of all Season Battle Pass missions.

【Winning Streak Protected! Defeat Shield Improved】

A narrow loss is no longer the end! When the Defeat Shield effect is triggered, it will now also protect your winning streak from being reset.

【Card Clarity Improved】

All Legendary (Orange) and Epic (Purple) follower cards now have more detailed ability descriptions, helping you better understand their mechanics.

【A Symbol of Honor! New Rank Icons Added】

Rank Icons will now be displayed in PVP Battle mode, showcasing your skill and honor more clearly!

【Card Collection UI Enhanced】

The Card Collection interface has been improved. You can now more clearly view information on how to obtain unowned cards.

【Hero Buffed: Gale Swordsman】

\[Gale Swordsman]'s "Blade Storm" skill has been buffed: It will now deal damage to all enemy followers, making it a true board-clearing threat!

【Equipment Interface Optimized】

The main character's equipment screen will now clearly display equipment slot locations, making it more intuitive to manage and equip items.

Thank you for your continuous support! Happy gaming!

notes.title: Maintenance and Update Announcement - June 19th
notes.content:
Dear \[Call of Clans] Players,

To provide you with an enhanced gaming experience, we are scheduled to perform server maintenance and an update on June 19th, 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours.

During this period, you will be temporarily unable to log into the game. Please plan your game time accordingly and log off in advance to avoid any unnecessary inconvenience. We sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause.

The key updates are as follows:


[olist]
【All-New Hero Battle Pass Introduced!】

The highly anticipated "Hero Battle Pass" system is coming soon! Complete tasks and level up your Battle Pass to unlock a wealth of exclusive hero rewards, rare items, and cool cosmetics!

【New Honor: Class Leaders!】

Introducing the "Class Leader" honorary title! At the end of each season, the top 3 players with the highest win rates in each of the game's four main classes  will be crowned "Class Leaders," showcasing their exceptional skill and understanding of their profession!

【Pre-battle Card Swap Feature Adjusted】

To optimize the early-game experience for new players, the "Pre-battle Card Swap" feature will now be unlocked upon reaching 1000 Cups.

【Battle Experience Enhanced: Global Buffs Clearly Displayed!】

The battle interface will now feature an intuitive display for active Global Buff effects. This will allow you to have a clearer understanding of the current buffs/debuffs on the battlefield, enabling better strategic decisions!

【High-Tier Arena Adjustment: Increased Winning Streak Rewards!】

For elite players above 8500 Cups, the maximum Cup reward for achieving winning streaks in the Arena has been increased to +60 Cups! We encourage top players to strive for even greater heights and glory!
[/olist]
Thank you for your continuous support and passion for Call of Clans. We will keep working hard to make Call of Clans even better for you!

notes.title: Maintenance and Update Announcement - May 22nd
notes.content:
Dear [Call of Clans] Players,
To provide you with an enhanced gaming experience, we are scheduled to perform server maintenance and an update on May 22, 2025, from 15:00 to 17:00 (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 2 hours.
During this period, you will be temporarily unable to log into the game. Please plan your game time accordingly and log off in advance to avoid any unnecessary inconvenience. We sincerely apologize for any disruption this may cause.
The key updates are as follows:
A. Comprehensive Overhaul for Team Dungeons:
1. Richer Difficulty Tiers: The number of difficulty levels for all Team Dungeons will be increased from the original 3 to 5, offering more challenges and reward options!
2. New Dungeon & Rotation System:
* A brand-new 7th Team Dungeon will be introduced, bringing diverse battles for you to explore!
* Dungeon Availability Change: Instead of all dungeons being open on Sundays, we are implementing a daily rotation system. One specific Team Dungeon will be available each day, for all 7 days of the week, providing a fresh experience daily.
3. Convenient Sweep Function Added: A new "Sweep" function will be available for Team Dungeons. After clearing a dungeon, you can use Sweep to quickly claim rewards, freeing up your hands for effortless progression!
B. New Benefit: Season Fund Coming Soon!
* Following the conclusion of the current Basic Fund event, a brand-new "Season Fund" will be launched with each future season reset! Unlock tons of valuable rewards to boost your seasonal journey!
C. Alliance Communication & Mutual Aid Enhancements:
1. Dedicated Alliance Channel: A new "Alliance Channel" will be added to the chat system, making it easier for alliance members to discuss strategies and share tips!
2. Card Donation Interface Optimized: The Alliance Card Donation interface has been refined for a more user-friendly and streamlined experience when donating or requesting cards.
Thank you for your continued support and passion for Call of Clans. We will keep working hard to make Call of Clans even better for you!

notes.title: Maintenance Announcement - April 18
notes.content:
Dear 《Call of Clans》 Players,
To bring you a better gaming experience, we plan to undergo scheduled maintenance from 10:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8) on April 18, 2025. The game will be temporarily unavailable during this period. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
Update Highlights:
【Main Update Content】
1.【PVE Experience Optimized】Hands-Free Gameplay!
A free System Auto-Play (Managed Play) feature will be available for all PVE modes (like Campaign, Tower of Trials, etc.). Clear stages effortlessly and save your energy!
2.【Weekly Card Perks Enhanced】Climb Faster!
New Weekly Card privilege: Receive an additional 2 hours of +5 Cups boost time daily. Rank up in the Arena more efficiently!
3.【Monthly Card Privileges Boosted】Incredible Value!
Two major new perks for Monthly Card holders:
Enjoy a 50% discount when using Purple Gems to open Battle Chests!
Gain the ability to refresh low-quality chests, say goodbye to bad luck and get the rewards you want faster!
4.【Orc Faction Units Buffed】War Drums Echo!
[Fierce Fighter]: Stats increased.
[Wolf Cavalry]: Stats increased.
[Blood Wolf Cavalry]: Skill effects enhanced.
The Orc legions have been strengthened! Prepare for a new storm on the battlefield!
5.【First Purchase Reward Optimized】Master Them Quickly!
Exclusive trial stages have been added for the heroes [Icy] and [Panda Master] obtained from the First Purchase reward, helping you quickly learn their powerful abilities!
6.【Season Update】Brand New Look!
A new season is coming soon! The Battle Pass will feature a cool, brand-new limited skin. Stay tuned!
7.【Online Reward Adjusted】Starting Boost!
The Day 1 Online Reward has been changed from [Evil Wizard] to the powerful [Bull Head Chief]. Get a head start on your journey!

notes.title: 3-6 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Call of Clans will undergo maintenance on March 6, 2025, from 14:00 to 16:00 (UTC+8) to enhance your gaming experience. The game will be temporarily unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly.

This update includes:

March 8th Goddess Festival Event Update: We're refreshing our special event for March 8th, offering new challenges and rewards to celebrate the occasion.
Optimized Odd Soldier Duel: We've fine-tuned our special competitive mode, Odd Soldier Duel, for a more balanced and thrilling experience.
Thank you for your understanding and support. We look forward to seeing you back in the game after the maintenance!

[Game Development Team]

notes.title: 2-25 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Call of Clans will undergo maintenance on February 25, 2025, from 10:00 to 12:00 (UTC+8) to enhance your gaming experience. The game will be temporarily unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Here are the update highlights:

New Solo Dungeon Mode: Adventure
Unlock at 4000 trophies! Challenge unique dungeons, explore unknown territories, and earn rich rewards.
Optimized In-Game Events
Refined events for better participation and rewards, adding more fun to your gameplay.
Removed Daily Purchase Limit on "Emperor's Chest"
obtaining rare items anytime.
Improved Settings Interface Layout
Redesigned settings menu for intuitive operation and easy customization.
Optimized Weekend Competitive Event Goals
Adjusted goals to be more achievable and enjoyable.
Thank you for your support and patience. We look forward to seeing you in-game after the maintenance! For questions or feedback, feel free to contact us.

Happy gaming!
